summary.text: Amr Metwally is the MGTOW Party candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race that also includes Wayne Richter (D), Anthony Bonna (R) and Hunter Stone (No Party Affiliation, write-in).
Ballotpedia also lists him as having sought the MGTOW Party nomination for Florida's 6th Congressional District, but he did not appear on that primary ballot.
